title: Book club
subtitle: 「讀書會／閱讀小組」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「讀書會／閱讀小組」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 和 book club 最直接、最自然的近義表達之一。
words.example: She joined a reading group at the local library.
words.exampleZh: 她參加了本地圖書館的閱讀小組。

exercises.original: She joined a book club at the local library.
exercises.zh: 她參加了本地圖書館的讀書會。
exercises.upgrade: She joined a reading group at the local library.

options.explanation: 和 book club 最直接、最自然地對應。
通常有正式教學，不等於以會員討論為主的讀書會。
表示讀者群，不是一個聚會小組。
重點是寫作，不是讀書討論。

exercises.original: Our book club meets every other Wednesday.
exercises.zh: 我們的讀書會每隔一個星期三聚會一次。
exercises.upgrade: Our reading group meets every other Wednesday.

options.explanation: 固定成員定期聚會，完全符合。
可能只是一場單次活動。

exercises.original: The book club is discussing a memoir this month.
exercises.zh: 這個讀書會本月正在討論一本回憶錄。
exercises.upgrade: The reading group is discussing a memoir this month.

options.explanation: 定期閱讀並討論書籍的群組。
通常是一場活動，不是固定小組。

words.note: 強調文學作品、小說、詩歌等內容。
words.example: The university literature club meets every Thursday.
words.exampleZh: 大學文學社每星期四聚會。

exercises.original: The school's book club focuses mainly on novels and poetry.
exercises.zh: 學校的讀書會主要閱讀小說和詩歌。
exercises.upgrade: The school's literature club focuses mainly on novels and poetry.

options.explanation: 小說和詩歌明顯指向文學作品。

exercises.original: The university book club invited a poet to speak.
exercises.zh: 大學文學社邀請了一位詩人演講。
exercises.upgrade: The university literature club invited a poet to speak.

options.explanation: 邀請作家／詩人是 literature club 很自然的活動。
可指讀者評審團，但不是固定讀書會。

exercises.original: Members of the book club are reading twentieth-century fiction.
exercises.zh: 讀書會成員正在閱讀二十世紀小說。
exercises.upgrade: Members of the literature club are reading twentieth-century fiction.

options.explanation: 特定文學類型閱讀很自然。

words.note: 和 book club 很接近，尤其常見於學校、兒童閱讀、圖書館活動。
words.example: The school runs a reading club for younger students.
words.exampleZh: 學校為低年級學生開設閱讀俱樂部。

exercises.original: The primary school started a book club for children aged eight to ten.
exercises.zh: 小學為八至十歲兒童成立閱讀俱樂部。
exercises.upgrade: The primary school started a reading club for children aged eight to ten.

options.explanation: 學校兒童閱讀活動很自然。
較正式、學術，不適合此處。

exercises.original: The library's book club aims to encourage teenagers to read more.
exercises.zh: 圖書館的閱讀俱樂部旨在鼓勵青少年多閱讀。
exercises.upgrade: The library's reading club aims to encourage teenagers to read more.

options.explanation: 培養閱讀習慣是 reading club 的典型功能。
可能也可，但通常更正式、更廣，不是最精確。

exercises.original: The book club chooses short novels that are accessible to new readers.
exercises.zh: 閱讀俱樂部選擇較容易入門的短篇小說。
exercises.upgrade: The reading club chooses short novels that are accessible to new readers.

words.meaning: 書籍討論小組；讀書討論會
words.note: 強調成員讀完書後一起討論內容、人物、主題和觀點。
words.example: Our book discussion group is reading a historical novel this month.
words.exampleZh: 我們的書籍討論小組本月正在讀一本歷史小說。

exercises.original: Our book club spends most of each meeting discussing themes and characters.
exercises.zh: 我們的讀書會大部分聚會時間都在討論主題和人物。
exercises.upgrade: Our book discussion group spends most of each meeting discussing themes and characters.

options.explanation: 討論內容是核心，非常精確。
是安靜閱讀，不以討論為主。
通常有老師和教學目標。

exercises.original: The book club will discuss the ending of the novel tonight.
exercises.zh: 讀書會今晚會討論小說結局。
exercises.upgrade: The book discussion group will discuss the ending of the novel tonight.

exercises.original: Members of the book club compare their interpretations of each chapter.
exercises.zh: 讀書會成員比較自己對每一章的理解。
exercises.upgrade: Members of the book discussion group compare their interpretations of each chapter.

words.meaning: 書籍討論俱樂部；讀書討論會
words.note: 和 book discussion group 非常接近，但保留 club 的社群感。
words.example: The library hosts a monthly book discussion club.
words.exampleZh: 圖書館每月舉辦一次書籍討論會。

exercises.original: The library runs a monthly book club with a moderator.
exercises.zh: 圖書館每月舉辦一次有主持人的讀書討論會。
exercises.upgrade: The library runs a monthly book discussion club with a moderator.

options.explanation: 固定聚會＋主持討論，非常自然。

exercises.original: The book club meets to discuss one selected title each month.
exercises.zh: 這個讀書會每月聚會討論一本指定書籍。
exercises.upgrade: The book discussion club meets to discuss one selected title each month.

options.explanation: 指定一本書＋定期討論，完全吻合。

exercises.original: She leads a book club that focuses on contemporary fiction.
exercises.zh: 她主持一個專門討論當代小說的讀書會。
exercises.upgrade: She leads a book discussion club that focuses on contemporary fiction.

options.explanation: 主持固定討論群體很自然。

words.note: 較正式，指以閱讀、文學討論、作家、作品或文學活動為核心的團體。
words.example: The literary society invited a novelist to speak at its annual event.
words.exampleZh: 文學社邀請了一位小說家在年度活動中演講。

exercises.original: The book club also organizes author talks and poetry evenings.
exercises.zh: 這個文學社亦舉辦作家講座和詩歌之夜。
exercises.upgrade: The literary society also organizes author talks and poetry evenings.

options.explanation: 活動範圍已超出單純讀一本書，literary society 更自然。

exercises.original: The university book club has existed for more than fifty years and hosts public lectures.
exercises.zh: 這個大學文學社已有超過五十年歷史，並舉辦公開講座。
exercises.upgrade: The university literary society has existed for more than fifty years and hosts public lectures.

options.explanation: 歷史悠久＋舉辦公開活動，較像正式文學社。

exercises.original: The book club publishes a small literary magazine each year.
exercises.zh: 這個文學社每年出版一本小型文學雜誌。
exercises.upgrade: The literary society publishes a small literary magazine each year.

options.explanation: 出版文學刊物符合較廣泛的 literary society 活動。
評審／讀者小組，不一定固定。

words.note: 指一小群人定期閱讀並討論文學作品。
words.example: The literature circle focuses on modern Asian fiction.
words.exampleZh: 這個文學小組專注閱讀現代亞洲小說。

exercises.original: A small book club meets to discuss modern Asian fiction.
exercises.zh: 一個小型文學小組聚會討論現代亞洲小說。
exercises.upgrade: A small literature circle meets to discuss modern Asian fiction.

options.explanation: 小型＋文學討論導向，很自然。

exercises.original: The book club has only eight members and focuses on poetry.
exercises.zh: 這個文學小組只有八名成員，主要閱讀詩歌。
exercises.upgrade: The literature circle has only eight members and focuses on poetry.

exercises.original: Their book club meets in members' homes and discusses classic novels.
exercises.zh: 他們的文學小組在會員家中聚會，討論經典小說。
exercises.upgrade: Their literature circle meets in members' homes and discusses classic novels.

options.explanation: 私人、小型、固定討論群體很合適。

words.note: 較溫和、社群感強，表示一群人一起閱讀和交流。
words.example: The community centre started a reading circle for retirees.
words.exampleZh: 社區中心為退休人士成立了一個閱讀圈。

exercises.original: The community centre started a book club for retirees.
exercises.zh: 社區中心為退休人士成立了一個閱讀圈。
exercises.upgrade: The community centre started a reading circle for retirees.

options.explanation: 社區、社交、閱讀交流語境很自然。

exercises.original: The book club meets informally over tea and discusses short stories.
exercises.zh: 這個閱讀圈以輕鬆形式一邊喝茶一邊討論短篇小說。
exercises.upgrade: The reading circle meets informally over tea and discusses short stories.

exercises.original: The language centre uses a book club to help learners practise discussion skills.
exercises.zh: 語言中心利用閱讀圈幫助學習者練習討論技巧。
exercises.upgrade: The language centre uses a reading circle to help learners practise discussion skills.

options.explanation: 語言學習＋交流導向非常自然。

words.note: 較口語、社群化，表示一群固定一起讀書和討論的人。
words.example: Our book circle chooses a new title every six weeks.
words.exampleZh: 我們的讀書圈每六星期選一本新書。

exercises.original: Our book club chooses a new novel every six weeks.
exercises.zh: 我們的讀書圈每六星期選一本新小說。
exercises.upgrade: Our book circle chooses a new novel every six weeks.

exercises.original: The book club has met in the same café for three years.
exercises.zh: 這個讀書圈三年來一直在同一家咖啡店聚會。
exercises.upgrade: The book circle has met in the same café for three years.

options.explanation: 固定社群長期聚會，很合適。

exercises.original: Members of the book club take turns choosing the next title.
exercises.zh: 讀書圈成員輪流選下一本書。
exercises.upgrade: Members of the book circle take turns choosing the next title.

options.explanation: 會員制、輪流選書，很自然。

words.note: 強調參與者作為 readers 的身份。
words.example: The museum formed a readers' group focused on art history.
words.exampleZh: 博物館成立了一個專門閱讀藝術史的讀者小組。

exercises.original: The museum started a book club about art history.
exercises.zh: 博物館成立了一個藝術史讀者小組。
exercises.upgrade: The museum started a readers' group about art history.

options.explanation: 文化機構成立固定閱讀群組，很自然。
是整體讀者群，不是一個會聚會的小組。

exercises.original: The book club is open to readers of all ages.
exercises.zh: 這個讀者小組歡迎所有年齡的讀者參加。
exercises.upgrade: The readers' group is open to readers of all ages.

options.explanation: 直接突出 members are readers。

exercises.original: The local history book club meets at the museum.
exercises.zh: 本地歷史讀者小組在博物館聚會。
exercises.upgrade: The local history readers' group meets at the museum.

options.explanation: 主題型固定閱讀小組很自然。

words.note: 非常直接、簡潔，是 book club 的自然變體。
words.example: My book group meets on the first Monday of every month.
words.exampleZh: 我的讀書小組每月第一個星期一聚會。

exercises.original: My book club meets on the first Monday of every month.
exercises.zh: 我的讀書小組每月第一個星期一聚會。
exercises.upgrade: My book group meets on the first Monday of every month.

exercises.original: The book club voted on which novel to read next.
exercises.zh: 讀書小組投票決定下一本讀哪部小說。
exercises.upgrade: The book group voted on which novel to read next.

options.explanation: 固定成員一起選書，非常自然。

exercises.original: Her book club is currently reading a crime novel.
exercises.zh: 她的讀書小組目前正在讀一本犯罪小說。
exercises.upgrade: Her book group is currently reading a crime novel.

words.meaning: 讀書小組；共同閱讀小組
words.note: 較描述性，強調一群人一起讀書。
words.example: The community project created a book-reading group for new residents.
words.exampleZh: 社區項目為新居民成立了一個讀書小組。

exercises.original: The community centre created a book club for new residents.
exercises.zh: 社區中心為新居民成立了一個共同閱讀小組。
exercises.upgrade: The community centre created a book-reading group for new residents.

options.explanation: 描述性地表達一起讀書的小組。

exercises.original: The project uses a book club to encourage social connection.
exercises.zh: 這個項目透過共同閱讀小組促進社交連結。
exercises.upgrade: The project uses a book-reading group to encourage social connection.

options.explanation: 如果需要向不熟悉 book club 的讀者解釋，這種描述性改寫很清楚。

exercises.original: The book club meets weekly to read and discuss short texts.
exercises.zh: 共同閱讀小組每週聚會閱讀和討論短篇文本。
exercises.upgrade: The book-reading group meets weekly to read and discuss short texts.

options.explanation: 考試導向，不是一般讀書會。

falseSynonyms.zh: 圖書館不等於讀書會 library 是地方／機構；book club 是一群人或活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We met at the library. We joined a book club at the library.

falseSynonyms.zh: 文學課不等於讀書會 class 通常有教師、課程目標和正式教學； book club 通常以會員討論為主。
閱讀時段不等於固定讀書會 reading session 可以只是一次閱讀活動，不一定有固定成員或長期聚會。
學習小組不等於讀書會 study group 通常為了考試、課程或完成學術任務。 book club 重點通常是閱讀與討論書籍。
寫作小組不等於讀書會 writing group 以創作、修改作品、互評為主。
文學活動不等於固定社群 一次 author talk 或 poetry reading 可以是 literary event，但不一定是 club。
可理解，但不是最自然固定詞 英文一般更常說：
falseSynonyms.point: - book club meeting - book discussion - reading group meeting

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞義和詞性不同 - reader = 讀者 - reading = 閱讀活動／讀物 - readership = 讀者群 - reading group = 閱讀小組
